title: lines dash fills patterns
name: Lines dash fills patterns
rule: Lines use dash styles; fills use patterns (max 4–5). Solid / dashed / dotted / dash-dot for series. Hatch/dot/grid for bars, area, pie — not for lines. Two colours per pattern (fill + stroke).
pass_when: Line series use dash styles; area/bar/pie fills use patterns (≤4–5) with two colours per pattern; patterns are not used on lines.
fail_when: Line series distinguished only by colour with no dash; patterns on lines; more than 5 fill patterns.
overview: Distinguish line series with dashes; use fill patterns on area, bar, and pie.
apply_when: Encoding multiple series with lines or patterned fills.
not_when: Colour-only line series, patterns on lines, or more than five fill patterns.
agent_hint: Use dash styles on lines and patterns on fills; cap patterns at four to five.
description: Lines use dash styles; fills use patterns (max 4–5). Solid, dashed, dotted, dash-dot for series. Hatch, dot, grid for bars, area, pie—not for lines. Two colours per pattern (fill plus stroke). Pass when line series use dash styles, area/bar/pie fills use ≤4–5 patterns with two colours each, and patterns are not used on lines. Fail when lines are colour-only with no dash, patterns sit on lines, or more than five fill patterns appear.
do_not_claim: Established colour conventions as a merge that drops dash/pattern.
